dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Wilson disease (ATP7B-related hepatolenticular degeneration with neurological copper accumulation)

ALTERNATIVE 1: Progressive supranuclear palsy, an age-related 4R-tauopathy

ALTERNATIVE 2: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 (Machado–Joseph disease), due to an ATXN3 CAG-repeat expansion

ALTERNATIVE 3: Niemann–Pick disease type C, due to NPC1/NPC2-related intracellular lipid accumulation
